question: Does the six-branch-point model identify the Jacobian 2-torsion as the difference of the elliptic 4-torsion extensions, with the transporter as its non-scalar component?
checks: Compare all signed permutations on even six-point subsets modulo complements with the predicted extension matrices.
Compare the same matrices with the quotient of pairs of mod-four vectors having equal parity.
Verify the scalar/norm-square decomposition for all eight sign vectors and its S3 equivariance.
Compute the exact commuting algebra and its idempotents.
Apply the already certified simple-collision witnesses to the six existing fibres.
failure_semantics: An abstract torsion-module calculation does not produce a CT value or a rational point. The decorated local conditions in the Baer-sum pairing must be retained; no identification with an ordinary genus-two Selmer computation is assumed.
